ns2:section.sectionText: Online & Continuing Education (OCE) restrictions and assessments apply, see http://www.oce.illinois.edu. No class meeting on November 20. Final exam with ProctorU on 12/18/12. The course will be taught via Collaborate v.11 and Compass. Students will need a working external microphone/speakers or headset with microphone and reliable high-speed Internet. This section has one or more proctored exams, which may carry additional fees. Proctoring options include fee-based ProctorU and approved proctoring centers, and testing facilities located at the Online & Continuing Education offices on the Urbana-Champaign campus, which carry no fees.
